The '''[[1922 in association football|1922]]–[[1923 in association football|23]] season''' was the 31st season of [[The Football League]].

==Final league tables==
The tables and results below are reproduced here in the exact form that they can be found at [https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1922-23.html The Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation] website<ref name="rsssf">{{cite web |url=https://www.rsssf.org/engpaul/FLA/1922-23.html |title=England 1922-23 |publisher=Rec.Sport.Soccer Statistics Foundation|access-date=2010-02-24}}</ref> and in ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79'',<ref name="Rothmans">Ian Laschke: ''Rothmans Book of Football League Records 1888–89 to 1978–79''. Macdonald and Jane’s, London & Sydney, 1980.</ref> with home and away statistics separated.

Beginning with the season 1894–95, clubs finishing level on points were separated according to goal average (goals scored divided by goals conceded), or more properly put, goal ratio. In case one or more teams had the same goal difference, this system favoured those teams who had scored fewer goals. The goal average system was eventually scrapped beginning with the 1976–77 season. From the 1922–23 season on, [[Re-election (Football League)|Re-election]] was required of the bottom two teams of both Third Division North and Third Division South.<ref name=" Rothmans"/>
